name: TFM2 Patch Balance Improvement
summary: Adds actual stat/growth apply-vector duplicate protection so patch-note values and champion detail values stay aligned.
notes: Weak uses 80%..125%, normal uses 75%..133.33%, and strong uses 66.7%..150%.
Selected champion count and per-champion item count are kept at the strong-baseline volume for every intensity.
The r17 patch-note merge keep-first policy is retained.
r18 additionally guards the actual stat/growth apply vector at 0x141265340 and 0x1412654E0 so duplicate field entries cannot apply twice.
Intensity ranges are unchanged: weak 80%..125%, normal 75%..133.33%, strong 66.7%..150%.
